thinking:
*   Platform Name: 趣聊 (Qù Liáo) - a social media platform.
    *   Target Audience: Young adults (18-35).
    *   Pages Required: Home page (feed), User profile page, Single post page (with comments), Sign-up page.
    *   Goal: Attract users to join.
    *   Language: Simplified Chinese.
    *   Technical Constraints: Static website, multiple files, relative links, internal CSS/JS, no remote resources, no AI mentions, no "Lorem ipsum".
    *   Design: Professional, modern, responsive for 1440px.

    *   `index.html` (Home/Feed)
    *   `profile.html` (User Profile)
    *   `post.html` (Single Post)
    *   `signup.html` (Registration)

    *   Colors: Vibrant but clean. Maybe a primary color like a bright blue or purple to appeal to youth. Let's go with a modern Indigo/Violet theme.
    *   Typography: Sans-serif.
    *   Layout: Header (logo, nav, search), Main Content (feed/profile/form), Sidebar (suggested users/trending).

    *   *index.html*:
        *   Header: 趣聊 Logo, Search bar, Nav links (Home, Profile, Signup).
        *   Main: Post creation box, Feed of posts (User, Time, Text, Image placeholder, Like/Comment/Share buttons).
        *   Sidebar: Trending topics, Suggested friends.

    *   *profile.html*:
        *   Header: (Same as index).
        *   Main: User banner, Profile picture, Bio, Stats (Followers, Following).
        *   Grid: User's posted photos/updates.

    *   *post.html*:
        *   Header: (Same as index).
        *   Main: The specific post content, expanded image, detailed text.
        *   Comments Section: List of comments with user names and timestamps. Input field for new comment.

    *   *signup.html*:
        *   Header: (Same as index).
        *   Main: Centered signup card. Fields: Username, Email, Password, Birthday. Join button.

    *   *Simplified Chinese translations*:
        *   Home -> 首页
        *   Profile -> 个人主页
        *   Sign up -> 立即加入
        *   Post -> 发布
        *   Like -> 点赞
        *   Comment -> 评论
        *   Share -> 分享
        *   Trending -> 热门话题
        *   Suggested friends -> 推荐好友

    *   No remote CSS/JS. Use a single `<style>` block in each file or a shared style (but the prompt asks for files, I'll include styles in each to ensure they are standalone/deployable as requested).
    *   Ensure no "Lorem ipsum". Use real-sounding posts (e.g., travel, food, tech updates).
    *   Relative links: `href="index.html"`, etc.
